name: psychological factors in chronic pain overview
title: A patient with chronic pain: assess everyone, then decide whether the distress is more than chronic pain. If not, manage biologically, psychologically and by rehabilitation. If so, tell somatic symptom disorder, conversion disorder, factitious disorder and malingering apart by whether the behaviour is conscious and whether the gain is external, and assess and manage each

root.title: Chronic pain: is the distress MORE than chronic pain? (distressing symptoms with abnormal thoughts, feelings or behaviours)
lines: history: duration, nature, physical AND psychological symptoms incl. SUICIDAL THOUGHTS, what was tried, effect on function
review past investigations, new only if indicated · pain diary: rate the sensation and the distress SEPARATELY
